title: [main] bug 652323 - Move creating VAT Period to setup demo data level
summary: Moved VAT Period creation from Master Data to Setup Data level in Czech Contoso demo data to ensure VAT periods exist when setup-level processes depend on them, removing downstream test workarounds.
key_points: VAT Period and VAT Return Period now created at Setup Data level instead of Master Data level
Posting failures with 'VAT Period does not exist' error are resolved for CZ-localized databases
Removed workarounds that disabled VAT Reporting Date Usage in SCM Warehouse Orders and Subcontracting tests
Removed DisableVATDateUsage helper and VAT date disabling from E-Document Item Charge tests
Demo data sequencing fix; no schema, production logic or permission changes
